name: m3u.guide
description: Synchronizes Live TV, XMLTV, Movies and Shows from hosted m3u.guide accounts or standalone playlist providers.
overview: Connect Jellyfin to m3u.guide, Xtream, direct URLs, or server-local playlists.

versions.changelog: Resilient Live TV programme categorization for channels without provider EPG identifiers; deterministic fallback tvg-id support through m3u.guide exports; categorized placeholder programmes when real listings are unavailable; and automatic cleanup of stale plugin-owned tuner/listing registrations after source changes.

Credential-first Xtream Connect and Discover workflow; failed connections preserve the active source; independent Live, Movie and Series discovery; searchable paged movie/show title selection by stable provider ID; Legacy get.php discovery; and restored read-only hosted playlist source, mirror, active-origin and User-Agent details.

Standalone Xtream API and Legacy sources; encrypted provider credentials; canonical-origin and ordered-mirror failover; Live/Movie/Series category selection; bounded series expansion; XMLTV trimming and group-category injection; and an opaque restart-safe local playback relay with Range and User-Agent forwarding.

Direct M3U/XMLTV URL and server-local file source modes; shared local revision cache; local Live TV, movie and episode classification; generated STRM/NFO projections; and explicit source-mode dashboard controls.
Hybrid playlist-source seam, behavior-compatible remote m3u.guide source, and source-independent synchronization/materialization pipeline.
Integration-token inventory, last-use visibility, targeted revocation, safe current-token rotation, and dashboard device controls.
Series parse diagnostics, multilingual/date/absolute episode rules, stable-ID corrections, path/NFO previews, and dashboard editing.
Authoritative NFO metadata, remote-provider suppression with administrator opt-in, season NFO records, and Jellyfin library-scan reporting.
Canonical provider origins, ordered mirrors, non-destructive playback URL rewriting, User-Agent control, and credential-redacted endpoint health checks.
Synchronization status, phase/progress reporting, source/materialized/indexed counts, exact failure state, and mutually exclusive scoped refresh actions.
Revision-aware Live and VOD synchronization, resumable VOD checkpoints, safe staged replacement, delta reporting, revision consistency checks, and unchanged-work suppression.

Saved-token playlist discovery, remembered playlist/profile selection, searchable Live/Movie/Series group controls, unlimited full-catalog synchronization, profile-aware downloads, and synchronization/rescan actions.
Initial local integration, authentication and artifact synchronization.
